name: Tag Team Tactics
body:
School divination; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, paladin 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

With a word you become perfectly in sync with your comrade in arms. After you cast this spell, whenever you make an attack roll, the creature you targeted with this spell gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls against the target of your attack until the beginning of your next turn. If the targeted creature makes an attack roll, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against the target of their attack until the beginning of their next turn.
